title: Design System: Alliance Street — Priority Access Webinar

display.purpose: Hero H1 only, one per page. Sized to keep the whole hero within one viewport.

headline.purpose: Every section heading and CTA label.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, form labels, stat captions, footer headers.

shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: Resting shadow for opaque white cards.

shadows.name: glass-lift
shadows.purpose: Hero signup form and Credibility glass cards.

shadows.name: glass-hover
shadows.purpose: Credibility glass card hover: 6px lift + 1.5% scale.

motion.name: reveal-ease
motion.purpose: Scroll-triggered fade/slide-up reveals on section content.

motion.name: ui-ease
motion.purpose: Hover/focus transitions on buttons and inputs.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid red CTA — 'Continue', 'Confirm & join the list', 'Book a Consultation'.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #E4141A; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; font-size: 20px; height: 52px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(228,20,26,.28); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #F43A3F; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(228,20,26,.38); }

components.name: Secondary Button (dark canvas)
components.description: Translucent pill button for the dark canvas — 'I'll Wait for the Webinar', 'Learn More'.
components.html: I'LL WAIT FOR THE WEBINAR
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary-dark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; font-size: 19px; color: #EDEAE3; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.055); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); border-radius: 999px; padding: 17px 34px; transition: border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary-dark:hover { border-color: #E4141A; color: #E4141A; }

components.name: Card
components.description: White 'paperwork' card — testimonials, stat callouts, cover-topic cards.
components.html:
PRIORITY NOTIFICATION

Be among the first to know when the next webinar date is announced.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E7E7EC; border-radius: 18px; padding: 28px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(228,20,26,.14); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; font-size: 24px; color: #111113; margin: 0 0 16px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.6; color: #4A4A52; margin: 0; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text input inside the white form card, with focus glow.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 44px; border: 1px solid #D8D8DE; border-radius: 10px; padding: 0 14px; font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: #111113; background: #FFFFFF; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9A9AA2; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #E4141A; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(228,20,26,.14); }

components.name: Sticky Navigation
components.description: Dark blurred sticky header — logo + support link + primary CTA.
components.html: ALLIANCE STREETBOOK A CALL
components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 14px 48px; background: rgba(10,10,10,.92); backdrop-filter: blur(14px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.11); } .ds-logo { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; font-size: 20px; color: #EDEAE3; }

components.name: Eyebrow Badge
components.description: Pill badge above the hero headline — the only decorative chip in the system.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(228,20,26,0.5); background: rgba(228,20,26,0.12); border-radius: 999px; padding: 9px 18px; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; font-size: 14px; color: #EDEAE3; } .ds-badge-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 999px; background: #E4141A; display: block; }

narrative.overview:
The page reads as a near-black canvas — the same working-after-hours confidence as alliancestreet.ae — with a single hot-red accent that carries every point of emphasis: CTAs, active states, stat numerals, the recurring underline rule beneath headlines. Condensed, heavy, all-caps display type (Anton for hero-scale words, Barlow Condensed for section headlines and labels) does the shouting; everything else stays quiet. A fixed, barely-there fractal-noise grain sits over the whole canvas — enough to keep the black from feeling like a flat digital void, not enough to be decorative.

Against that dark field, white 'paperwork' cards surface wherever the page asks the visitor to commit something real: the signup form, testimonials, stat callouts. These cards are deliberately un-dark — they read as physical documents being handed across a desk, not as generic UI panels — which is the visual argument for the brand's core promise: this is a serious operator who handles real paperwork, not a startup collecting emails.

This is explicitly not the generic SaaS look: no cream/beige surfaces, no pastel gradients, no oversized soft-rounded corners, no gradient-fill buttons. Red is scarce by design.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black canvas (#0A0A0A) with a fixed fractal-noise grain overlay (opacity 0.035)
One accent color (#E4141A red) carrying all emphasis; no secondary/tertiary brand colors
White 'paperwork' cards as the only light surfaces, always for commitment moments (forms, proof, numbers)
Two liquid-glass exceptions (hero form, Credibility cards) where the photo/canvas behind should read through
A Dubai-skyline photograph behind the hero only, under a directional scrim; every other section is bare canvas
Condensed/display caps typography for anything that needs authority; humanist sans for reading
Depth comes from red-tinted shadows, never neutral gray

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Red is the only brand color. If a second accent color feels necessary, the fix is spacing or type weight, not a new hue.

rules.name: The No-Mixed-Surface Rule
rules.body: Dark-canvas text colors (Bone / Bone Dim) never appear inside a white card, and light-card text colors never appear directly on the dark canvas. Each surface owns its own ramp.

rules.name: The All-Caps Authority Rule
rules.body: Anything meant to carry weight (headings, labels, buttons) is uppercase and condensed. Anything meant to be read comfortably (paragraphs) is sentence case and regular-width.

rules.name: The Red Shadow Rule
rules.body: Opaque surfaces never take a neutral black/gray shadow — theirs is always red-tinted. Glass surfaces are the one exception: they pair a deep neutral shadow (for volume) with a red glow (for brand), never a neutral shadow alone.

rules.name: The One-Screen Hero Rule
rules.body: On desktop (>1100px) the hero fills exactly one viewport: min-height calc(100vh - 80px), vertically centered, with the headline, body copy, checks, stat card and the entire signup form above the fold. Nothing may grow without a compensating trim. Below 1100px the lock releases and the stacked layout scrolls.

dos: Do keep red as the only accent — no second brand hue, ever.
Do tint every shadow with red instead of neutral black/gray.
Do keep dark-canvas text (Bone/Bone Dim) and light-card text (Card Ink/Body/Muted) strictly separated by surface.
Do use uppercase condensed type for anything meant to command attention; sentence-case Barlow for anything meant to be read.
Do collapse every multi-column grid to a single stacked column below 1100px, and disable the form card's position: sticky at that same breakpoint.
donts: Don't introduce a cream/beige/pastel surface anywhere — surfaces are the #0A0A0A canvas, an opaque white card, or translucent white glass; never a tinted mid-tone.
Don't reach for glass decoratively — it is earned only where the photo or canvas behind the surface should read through (hero form, Credibility cards). Everywhere else stays opaque.
Don't let anything grow the desktop hero past one viewport without trimming something else (see the One-Screen Hero Rule).
Don't use a gradient fill on any button or heading — solid red only.
Don't add a second accent color, even for 'informational' or 'success' states — reuse red or a bone/gray tint instead.
Don't give a card a heavier-than-1px border or a side-stripe accent border.
Don't round corners past 22px (or 999px for true pills) — nothing in this system is that soft.
